label: Why can many creatures receive existence if subsistent existence itself is unique?
summary: See docs/notes/contingency-receptivity-c2.md#does-depending-on-nothing-identify-one-being-as-god. The question about C2 stipulates an actual bearer of the empty existential-dependence profile. Identity by ultimate givers would collapse two creatures sustained wholly by one God. Identity by all strict ancestors in a well-founded transitive order forces pairwise comparability. The received-act account answers the creature objection by allowing determinate recipients and designated matter in material individuals. A non-self-actualizing essence plus the open requirement of a giver for received existence excludes even a single brute, finite recipient from roothood. Addition-excluding subsistent esse has no receiving essence, differentiating restriction or individuating matter. This gives a positive preference for its unity, conditional on the scope of that account and its account of real multiplication. Whole-kind determination without reception and primitive numerical plurality challenge different steps. The existing five-being control distinguishes relabeling two contributors from identifying them, without establishing actual independent contributors. A universal giver in the very relation the actual root lacks must be that root. The established governor route can identify this individual with an intellectual source and apply the full divine description under its additional premises. Unique occupation within each world still leaves de re necessary existence open. No new formal argument.
blocker: An absence of incoming existential dependence alone does not warrant reading every root as addition-excluding subsistent esse. The substantive issues are whether intrinsically determinate existence can be wholly unreceived and whether unrestricted existence could be numerically multiplied without a real basis of difference. To revise, warrant the receiver/giver and multiplication principles across rival sources, independently identify a universal giver in the selected respect, or exhibit a positive explanation that requires distinct, individually underived contributions. An inference to de re necessity through the root role also needs occupancy in every relevant world and a reason to identify its occupant throughout with n. Mere existence of n there would not by itself require that n be the root there.
